title: How Nature Index Tables Are Made
title_zh: 自然指数表格是怎么做出来的
lead: Nature Index makes tables about infectious diseases. This guide explains how they are made.
lead_zh: 自然指数制作关于传染病的表格。本指南解释这些表格是怎么做出来的。

The team searched for 83 infectious diseases. They also searched for 5 subcategories. These include severe coronaviruses and influenza subtypes. They used the same search as in 2021.

body:
The 2026 Nature Spotlight is about infectious diseases. The tables come from the Nature Index database. They cover articles published from 2021 to 2025. The articles are in science and health journals.

The team searched for 83 infectious diseases. They also searched for 5 subcategories. These include severe coronaviruses and influenza subtypes. They used the same search as in 2021.

The search used titles and abstracts. It looked in the Dimensions database. Digital Science runs Dimensions. Digital Science is part of Holtzbrinck. Holtzbrinck is the majority shareholder of Springer Nature. Springer Nature publishes Nature.

The team found articles in Dimensions. Some of these articles were also in the Nature Index database. Those articles formed the data set. The tables in this Spotlight use this data set.

SPOTLIGHT
07 October 2026
A guide to Nature Index tables
Information on the methodology used in the ranking for the 2026 Nature Spotlight: Infectious diseases.

The tables for the 2026
Nature Spotlight: Infectious diseases
are based on the
Nature Index database
and cover infectious-disease articles published in natural-science and health-science journals between 2021 and 2025.
Nature Spotlight: Infectious diseases
A keyword search on abstracts and titles was conducted to extract infectious-disease articles in Digital Science’s Dimensions database (Digital Science is part of Holtzbrinck, the majority shareholder of
Nature
’s publisher, Springer Nature). The search covered 83 infectious diseases and included 5 subcategories to cover severe coronaviruses and influenza subtypes. The
diseases and their Dimensions search strings
were the same as those for
Nature Index 2021 Infectious disease
. The Dimensions articles identified that were also in the Nature Index database formed the data set for the tables in this Spotlight.
